description: Global spell/ability records. Established by EXP-0026: the $C46AC0 14-byte record table (CEN-BATTLE-0004) doubles as the spell database — records 0-53 are the magic spells, ids shared with the 7-byte name table at ROMFILE:0x26F567 (CEN-MAGIC-0003). Names decode via the fixed-font byte encoding (CEN-MENU-0006). Bulk name text stays in local artifacts per docs/legal/ASSET_POLICY.md; this inventory stores ids, offsets, numbers, flags, and observation-sourced display names only.

fields.byte2: flags: bit0 physical formula, bit7 MP-path dispatch (Confirmed)
fields.byte3: bit7 MP retarget (Confirmed); other bits unknown
fields.byte4: mode: bit7 base variant, bit1 flip chain, bit0 party halving (Confirmed)
fields.byte5: MP cost (Strong hypothesis: single on-screen anchor Cure=5; families coherent)
fields.byte9: flag byte, ASL post-processed (Confirmed loader-side; semantics unknown)

availability.wram: +$1A6E + 54*character_slot (54 bytes per character, $FF = known; stride beyond slot 0 is a hypothesis)

records.name_source: menu tilemap decode + ROM name record 0 (EXP-0026)
records.mp_cost_status: inferred from record byte 5 (Strong-hypothesis field); not yet observed on screen — the field menu showed 0 for the dim entry

records.name_source: menu screenshot + tilemap decode + ROM name record 45 (EXP-0026)
records.mp_cost_status: observed on screen; matches record byte 5

unknowns: true spell count (54 inferred from class-icon structure, Tentative)
menu grid ordering rule (Cure renders first despite id 45)
